subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should maintainers require a successful baseline/candidate Telegram proof artifact for this stacked draft before any landing decision, or accept the current skipped Mantis artifact as enough proof context?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible, but the live proof runner failed to start the generated-image scenario and this draft intentionally crosses the split PR boundaries.

options.title: Require successful combined proof
options.body: Keep this draft non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs show baseline missing or blocking the marker image and this PR delivering exactly one image.

options.title: Accept scheduler/artifact proof only
options.body: Maintainers can decide that source-level scheduler proof is sufficient for this internal path and proceed through the split PRs while noting that visible proof remains unavailable.

options.title: Close the stack after it serves its purpose
options.body: If the proof runner cannot exercise this scenario or equivalent proof lands elsewhere, close this draft and keep the implementation and harness PRs as the active boundaries.

recommendation.title: Require successful combined proof
recommendation.body: Keep this draft non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs show baseline missing or blocking the marker image and this PR delivering exactly one image.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision centers on Telegram/Mantis proof-harness reliability, where vincentkoc has the strongest recent history signal.
